overall: An outstanding, well-researched ethics report. Ethical issues, organisational context and stakeholders are thoroughly identified; arguments are balanced, evidence-based and quantitatively supported; the decision rule, option table and multi-stakeholder recommendations flow logically to a justified conclusion. Only minor formatting and abstract-length issues prevent a perfect structure mark.
